messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-19-notifier]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-04 to 2025-06-19; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-06-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-12]
- The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is owned by Team Atlas. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for the notifier?

message.reasoning: The notifier ownership: latest entry says as of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune, valid to now. So answer: Team Dune.
